reviews.text:
This was my first time bringing my dog ​​in for grooming. It was also my first time, and I didn't know what to expect, so I pretty much left it up to them, and they did a fantastic job!

I was so happy to receive lots of photos and videos of my dog ​​during the shampoo and grooming.

I was thrilled to receive photos of my dog ​​looking all dressed up at home a few days later.

The speedy service was great because it was so stressful for my dog.

I'm already looking forward to the next grooming appointment. I'm sure my dog ​​is looking forward to it too! (^^)
I had my Golden Retriever shampooed. I was a little nervous because there were so many lovely ladies and dogs around, but they were very kind and attentive.

I brought my 4-month-old Pomeranian in for his first grooming session.

They finished everything in just under an hour, which was very quick, but he came back fluffy and smelling wonderful! I'm also happy with how they trimmed his rear end into a nice, round shape.

I recently used their services for the first time as a model dog. I had used their services as a model dog before, but the cuts were done by students, so the quality was hit or miss. However, I was very satisfied with the results at this shop; you wouldn't even think my dog ​​was a model dog! The staff were also very polite and kind. I would like to use their services again in the future.

I had passed by the shop on a walk before and had been curious about it ever since!

This was my first time using their grooming service, and they gave me a thorough consultation, listening carefully to all my requests. My dog ​​looks neat and tidy just in time for summer, and it's a great change of pace! 😊
I would definitely like to use their services again in the future! ✨

This dog was brought from Japan, and this was its first grooming session here.

Its fur is always prone to tangling, so we usually cut it short, but
I was very surprised that they were able to cut it so beautifully while leaving some length.

My dog ​​is almost a year old, and her fur has finally grown in evenly, so I took her in for her first grooming session.

I received lots of videos and cute photos of the process, which was great because I could see how she was doing. I was worried, but by the time I picked her up, she had already warmed up to the groomer and seemed reluctant to leave.

The shampoo, cut, and grooming were all completed in about an hour and a half, and they even took some cute photos. I was surprised by their efficiency. The cut was beautiful, right down to her paws, and my whole family is delighted, saying "She's so cute!" every time we see her.

I'd like to take her back in when her fur grows out again.

We used your service for our dog's first shampoo after bringing him home!

I was a little anxious because I wasn't familiar with grooming salons, but you listened carefully to my concerns and explained everything thoroughly, so I felt at ease leaving him in your care.

You even showed us a video of him during the shampoo, and he was treated so kindly that he was in a good mood when we got home. Thank you so much!

We will definitely use your service again!

It was my first time using your services, and I was incredibly impressed by the wonderful customer service and the wide range of services offered.
I entrusted you with my sick dog, who is nearing the end of his life, and my puppy, who was having his first grooming session, so it must have been difficult for you, but they were both so beautiful and adorable.
I'm so glad.
I also received photos... I was so happy to receive these photos since I couldn't take them myself.

I used their hotel service. I've also used their grooming salon before, and there were no problems there.

In short, they say they charge extra for dogs that are difficult to care for.

This time, I used their hotel service, but my dog ​​peed and defecated in the middle of the night, and when the staff came in the morning, they had stepped in it. They said it was a lot of work to wash it every time, so they'd charge an extra 1000 yen next time.

I haven't trained my dog ​​not to defecate at night, and since he's an indoor dog, I haven't trained him to only defecate outside.

The salon's excuse was something like, "We take him for walks in the morning and evening, and he defecates there, but he also defecates at night."

My dog ​​sometimes defecates at night too, but he hasn't stepped in it since he was a puppy.

I think it's probably because the cage is small and he stepped in it due to his size.

I felt terrible for making him sleep in such a small space at night.

Feeding, walking, and cleaning up after your pet are the bare minimum for a pet hotel, so how dare they raise prices next time because it's difficult?

I will never use their services again.

This is a shop that only thinks in terms of pandering.
